title: Projection mate naturality and unit normalization for etale coefficients
statement: For any commutative ring A, morphism f:X→Y, M∈D(X_et,A), N∈D(Y_et,A), and t:N→A_Y, the ordinary projection map Rf*M tensor N→Rf*(M tensor f*N), followed by Rf* of identity tensor (f*t followed by the canonical pullback unit comparison), followed by Rf* of the right unitor, equals identity on Rf*M tensor t followed by the right unitor. All maps are the canonical maps on the ordinary unbounded categories of [def-sfb-etale-coordinate-trace-data]. No properness, finiteness or boundedness is required.

proof.text:
apply naturality in the second argument of rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap
to t:N→A_Y. It reduces the composite to tensoring t with the identity on Rf*M,
followed by projection at the tensor unit, then Rf* of identity tensor the pullback
unit comparison and the right unitor. The tensor-unit projection is the right unitor
followed by Rf* of the inverse right unitor and inverse pullback-unit comparison,
by rightAdjointProjectionMap_app_app_tensorUnit. The pullback oplax unit is the
specified leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso by its normalization on degree-zero complexes.
The inverse unit comparison and the two right unitors cancel inside Rf*. The remaining
map is precisely identity tensor t followed by the right unitor. This calculation needs
no properness or coefficient finiteness. In Lean the tensor-unit identity is Adjunction.rightAdjointProjectionMap_app_app_tensorUnit in the source ProjectionMapUnit module; leftDerivedUpperStarOplaxMonoidal_η identifies the unit comparison. The existing natural transformation supplies naturality directly. A general coefficient-category helper avoids comparing two concretely elaborated derived monoidal instances.

lean.statement:
theorem projectionTraceNormalization {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (N : DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (t : N ⟶ constantComplex A Y) :
    ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app M).app N ≫
        (push A f).map
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map
              ((pull A f).map t ≫
                (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom) ≫
            (derivedTensorRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X M).hom) =
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).obj ((push A f).obj M)).map t ≫
        (derivedTensorRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y ((push A f).obj M)).hom
